name: sentry
description: Application monitoring, error tracking, and performance observability for production software through the official Model Context Protocol Sentry server. Look up issues by ID or URL, pull the most recent stacktrace, inspect error frequency and last-seen timestamps, and triage crashes and exceptions recorded by Sentry.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate production errors, crashes, and stacktraces from Sentry.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can help you debug production issues by looking up errors in Sentry — fetching stacktraces, checking error frequency, and helping you triage what needs attention. No more switching to the Sentry dashboard for every crash report. Just give your agent a Sentry issue URL or error ID, and it will pull the full details, stacktrace, and context so you can understand and fix the problem faster.
defaultPrompt: Look up this Sentry issue and show me the stacktrace.
What errors have been happening most frequently lately?
Is this production error still occurring or has it been resolved?
